observation.command: cd /opt && timeout 300 curl -sSL -o liquibase.zip "https://github.com/liquibase/liquibase/releases/download/v5.0.4/liquibase-5.0.4.zip" && unzip -q liquibase.zip && rm liquibase.zip && export LIQUIBASE_HOME=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4 && $LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase --version 2>&1 | head -4
